Geocon is a California-based professional engineering consulting firm founded in 1971, specializing in geotechnical engineering, engineering geology, environmental consulting, geotechnical instrumentation, and construction inspections. Professional registration (e.g., PG or CEG in California) or eligibility and intent to obtain registration.
Strong technical writing, data interpretation, and report preparation skills.
Ability to work safely in the field, manage multiple projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Proficiency with GIS, geologic modeling, and common office software; prior experience in geotechnical consulting is required.

About The Role

Every prescription CenterWell Pharmacy fills depends on a chain of people being in the right place at the right time. The Workforce Planning team makes sure that capacity exists before the demand arrives. The team conducts long-term forecasts that impact hiring, mid-term capacity plans that shape staffing strategy, and short-term plans that hold service levels week to week.

If you have done demand planning or S&OP for a physical supply chain, this is the same discipline — our constrained resource is licensed, trained people instead of inventory.

We are building this function from the ground up. The architecture, the metrics, and the tooling are not decided yet, and we are hiring two Senior Data Analysts to help decide them.
